final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS ob, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avgfill, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS dcnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.orderbase), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(dcnt) AS tot FROM s1) SELECT s1.ob, s1.avgfill, s1.dcnt, CASE WHEN s2.tot = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(s1.dcnt AS REAL) / s2.tot END AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL
